statement: The recorded “open” value is not safe to treat as flight-ready because sector 7 has a 12:00–23:00 ban and the current time is unknown, so I will place the area on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the recorded "open" value "is not safe to treat as flight-ready" because of the conflicting 12:00–23:00 ban, naming the specific contradiction.
